result.reasoning: 根据需求文档的章节结构和复杂度，将需求分析任务按业务模块拆分，确保每个analyze任务聚焦一个明确的业务领域。设计、图表和测试任务保持统一。

tasks.description: 需求分析：案件注册模块

contextHints.note: 提取案件注册相关的实体和功能

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须为所有用户界面上的所有可能操作和场景提供详细的上下文相关帮助材料
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供界面让用户记录应用程序中的任何缺陷或增强请求并跟踪
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够向用户发送警报（如电子邮件、短信），当用户选择时，每当对警报采取任何行动时
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should send alerts (e.g., email, SMS) to the user if the user chooses to whenever any action has been taken on the alert.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够维护不可更改的审计跟踪，自动捕获和存储关键实体的操作信息
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word 'unalterable' is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

availableConstraints.description: 审计跟踪功能激活后，系统必须无需人工干预跟踪事件并存储审计跟踪信息
availableConstraints.sourceText: Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须维护审计跟踪至少与相关案件的寿命一样长
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must maintain the audit trail for as long as required, which will be at least for the life of the case to which it refers.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须确保审计跟踪数据在请求时可被检查
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够导出指定案件的审计跟踪（不影响系统存储的审计跟踪）
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to export audit trails for specified cases (without affecting the audit trail stored by the System). This functionality can be used by external auditors who wish to examine or analyse system activity.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够捕获和存储访问控制机制的违规和尝试违规
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to capture and store violations (i.e. A user's attempts to access a case to which he is denied access), and (where violations can validly be attempted) attempted violations, of access control mechanisms.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许用户将案件访问限制为指定用户或用户组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应提供基于角色的功能控制
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should provide for role-based control for the functionality within the system

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许用户成为多个组的成员
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow a user to be a member of more than one group.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须仅允许管理员用户设置用户配置文件并将用户分配到组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须仅允许超级用户更改组或用户的安全属性
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow changes to security attributes for groups or users (such as access rights, security level, privileges, password allocation and management) to be made only by super-user.

availableConstraints.description: 如果用户请求访问或搜索他们没有权限访问的案件，系统必须提供可配置的响应选项
availableConstraints.sourceText: If a user requests access to, or searches for, a case which he does not have the right to access, the System must provide one of the following responses (selectable at configuration time):These options are presented in order of increasing security. Note that the requirement in the third option (i.e. the most stringent) implies that the System must not include such cases in any count of search results; this level of security is normally appropriate for cases dealing with matters such as national security.

availableConstraints.description: 系统在搜索结果列表中绝不能包含用户无权访问的任何记录
availableConstraints.sourceText: If a user performs a quick or advanced search, the System must never include in the search result list any record which the user does not have the right to access.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须记录用户对案件的无权访问尝试到审计跟踪中
availableConstraints.sourceText: If the System allows users to make unauthorised attempts to access cases, it must log these in the audit trail.

availableConstraints.description: 系统产生的所有错误消息必须是有意义的
availableConstraints.sourceText: All error messages produced by the System must be meaningful, so that they can be appropriately acted upon by the users who are likely to see them. Ideally, each error message will be accompanied by explanatory text and an indication of the action(s) which the user can take in response to the error.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须采用单一的用户界面规则集，提供熟悉和共同的外观和感觉
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must employ a single set of user interface rules, or a small number of sets to provide a familiar and common look and feel for the application.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够同时显示多个实体（案件、嫌疑人）
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to display several entities (cases, suspects) simultaneously.

availableConstraints.description: 界面必须尽可能可定制或用户可配置，并将配置保存在用户配置文件中
availableConstraints.sourceText: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

availableConstraints.description: 系统用户界面必须适合有特殊需求的用户
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System user interface must be suitable for users with special needs; that is, compatible with specialist software that may be used and with appropriate interface guidelines

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够在5-8秒内执行简单搜索，在10-15秒内执行高级搜索
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够在5-8秒内检索并显示过去2个月内访问过的案件
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for rapid retrieval of frequently-used cases, on the understanding that frequency of use is typically correlated with recent use.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够在20秒内检索并显示过去2个月内未访问过的案件
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for cases where cases used infrequently are stored on slower media than more active records.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须可扩展，不能有任何功能会妨碍在不同规模的警察局使用
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System be scaleable and must not have any features which would preclude use in small or large police stations, with varying numbers of cases handled.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持多语言界面
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support multilingual interface

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为在设备或通信网络故障时不会丢失操作数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed in manner that operational data is not lost in case of any failure of equipment or communication network.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持HTTPS作为通信协议
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should use HTTPS as the communication protocol, i.e., HTTP over an encrypted secure socket layer (SSL)

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持选择性加密存储数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support selective encryption of the stored data

availableConstraints.description: 系统应确保通过网络安全传输数据，使用SSL和双向数字签名
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should ensure secure transmission of data over the network and utilize SSL and 2-way digital signatures

availableConstraints.description: 系统应防止跨站脚本攻击
availableConstraints.sourceText: Prevent cross-site scripting

availableConstraints.description: 系统应防止SQL注入
availableConstraints.sourceText: Prevent SQL Injection

availableConstraints.description: 系统不应允许硬删除，只应执行软标记行以进行删除
availableConstraints.sourceText: Do not allow hard delete and perform only soft tagging the row for deletion

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用缓存存储频繁使用的数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: Use of cache for storing frequent data

availableConstraints.description: 搜索结果应从数据库中以10或20个为一批获取
availableConstraints.sourceText: The search results should be fetched from the database in batches of 10 or 20 maximum as configured within the application

availableConstraints.description: 搜索应仅获取需要显示给用户的字段
availableConstraints.sourceText: The search should fetch only the fields that need to be displayed to the user. Only when the user clicks on a particular record to view its further details should a query be fired to fetch the additional details for this particular record only

availableConstraints.description: 应在用于搜索的关键列上应用数据库索引
availableConstraints.sourceText: Database Indexes should be applied on the key columns used for searching

availableConstraints.description: 系统用户界面应符合ISO 9241标准
availableConstraints.sourceText: The user interfaces of the system should comply with Standard ISO 9241.

availableConstraints.description: 应用程序徽标应作为主页链接在所有页面上可用
availableConstraints.sourceText: The application logo to be available on all pages as a link to the home page.

availableConstraints.description: 所有非文本媒体对象应提供等效的文本描述
availableConstraints.sourceText: All non-text media objects, such as graphical images or video, should be provided with alternative equivalent textual descriptions and/or with equivalent text-based functionality.

availableConstraints.description: 导航应设计为帮助用户理解他们在哪里、去过哪里以及下一步可以去哪里
availableConstraints.sourceText: Navigation should be designed to help users understand where they are, where they have been and where they can go next. General guidance on achieving self-descriptiveness is given in ISO 9241-110.

availableConstraints.description: 每个呈现段应提供用户在导航结构中位置的清晰指示
availableConstraints.sourceText: Each presentation segment (page or window) should provide the user with a clear and sufficient indication of where he or she is in the navigation structure and of the current segment position with respect to the overall structure.

availableConstraints.description: 应提供替代访问路径以支持不同的导航策略
availableConstraints.sourceText: Alternative access paths for navigating to a specific unit of content should be offered to support different navigation strategies.

availableConstraints.description: 应尽量减少到达特定内容所需的导航步骤
availableConstraints.sourceText: The number of navigation steps needed to reach a certain piece of content should be minimized as long as different mental models, navigation strategies and tasks of the user are taken into account.

availableConstraints.description: 除非提供有用的内容或反馈，否则应避免使用启动画面
availableConstraints.sourceText: Splash screens should be avoided unless they provide useful content or feedback about the application state to the user. If a splash screen is used, a navigation option to skip it should be offered.

availableConstraints.description: 除非支持用户任务，否则应避免打开不必要的窗口
availableConstraints.sourceText: Additional windows such as new browser windows or pop-up windows should only be opened if this supports the user's task. Opening new windows can distract, confuse or impede users for a variety of reasons. They can superimpose the primary window, hiding relevant information. They could make it cognitively more difficult to understand the navigation structure with negative effects on both usability and accessibility. They also require additional user actions for closing unwanted windows.

availableConstraints.description: 应尽量减少垂直滚动，尽可能避免水平滚动
availableConstraints.sourceText: Vertical scrolling should be minimized. This may be done by placing important information at the top and providing links to information that is further down the page. Horizontal scrolling should be avoided wherever possible.

availableConstraints.description: 用户界面应设计为允许通过各种输入设备激活控件
availableConstraints.sourceText: User interfaces should be designed to allow activation of controls by a variety of input devices. The ability to choose between different input devices for activating controls such as links, fields and buttons is important both for users who prefer a certain input mode, mobile users and users with disabilities. In general, device independence can be achieved if the functionality is operable via a keyboard.

availableConstraints.description: 用户界面应设计为尽可能健壮以应对技术变化
availableConstraints.sourceText: Making user interfaces robust: User interfaces should be designed to be as robust as possible in the face of changing technology. This encompasses being able to present content containing newer technologies by older user agents as well as designing content to be usable with future technologies.

availableConstraints.description: 应用程序页面应设计为在预期技术使用环境下有可接受的打开和下载时间
availableConstraints.sourceText: Application pages should be designed and implemented so that there are acceptable opening times and download times for the expected range of technical contexts of use (e.g. bandwidth between the application and the user). This is particularly important for frequently accessed pages or pages that are important for user navigation and exploration, such as the home page.

availableConstraints.description: 应尽量减少潜在用户错误和从错误中恢复所需的努力
availableConstraints.sourceText: Minimizing user errors: Potential user errors as well as the effort needed to recover from errors should be minimized.

availableConstraints.description: 错误消息应清楚地说明错误原因和可能的解决操作
availableConstraints.sourceText: Providing clear error messages: The content of error messages shown on the pages or special error pages should clearly state the reason why the error occurred and, if possible, actions the user can take to resolve the error. Users expect error messages to be in the same language as the user interface.

availableConstraints.description: 用户应能够调整文本大小
availableConstraints.sourceText: Making text resizable by the user: Text should be able to be resized by the user, using functions provided by the user agent or other appropriate means i.e. see ISO 9241-171.

availableConstraints.description: 文本内容的质量在拼写和语法方面应足够不影响可读性
availableConstraints.sourceText: Text quality: The quality of textual content with respect to spelling and grammar should be sufficient so as not to impede readability.

availableConstraints.description: 应支持快速浏览文本，通过提供清晰的链接、项目符号列表等
availableConstraints.sourceText: Supporting text skimming: Fast skimming of text should be supported by the provision of clear links, bulleted lists, highlighted keywords, logical headings, and short phrases and sentences.

availableConstraints.description: 页面内链接应与其他链接明显区分
availableConstraints.sourceText: Distinguishable within-page links: Within-page links should be clearly distinguishable from other links that lead to a different page. EX. Within-page links are shown with dashed rather than solid underlines

availableConstraints.description: 应避免链接过载，以免影响文本可读性
availableConstraints.sourceText: Avoiding link overload: Text pages containing large proportions of links should be formatted so that the presence of links does not impede the readability of the text.

availableConstraints.description: 导航链接应使用用户熟悉的术语标记
availableConstraints.sourceText: Using familiar terminology for navigation links: Navigation links — particularly links representing the main navigation structure — should be labelled with terms that are familiar to the user, based on his/her general knowledge, prior experience in the application domain or experience of using other systems.

availableConstraints.description: 链接标签应描述性地指示其目标或目的
availableConstraints.sourceText: Using descriptive link labels: The target or purpose of a link should be directly indicated by its label, avoiding generic labels such as 'go' or 'click here' except where the purpose of the link is clear from its context on the page or the labels have commonly understood semantics in the particular application domain. Using appropriate terminology specific to the user's tasks and information needs is important for making the content easy to understand.

availableConstraints.description: 打开新窗口的链接应明确标记
availableConstraints.sourceText: Marking links opening new windows: Links that open new browser windows or pop-up windows should be clearly marked.

availableConstraints.description: 导航链接应与操作控件明显区分
availableConstraints.sourceText: Distinguishing navigation links from controls: Navigation links should be clearly distinguishable from controls activating some action. Typical action types in user interfaces include manipulating application data, performing searches, communication actions, such as opening a new e-mail window or starting a chat function, and presentation-related actions, such as sorting a list of search results.

availableConstraints.description: 如果文档太长或布局不适合在线阅读，应提供可打印版本
availableConstraints.sourceText: Providing printable document versions: If a document is either too long, dispersed over several pages or in a specific layout that is not suitable for online reading, a printer-friendly version of the document should be provided that prints the content in a form acceptable to the user (e.g. in the expected layout, paper format, or orientation).

availableConstraints.description: 应谨慎使用空白，不影响页面的视觉浏览
availableConstraints.sourceText: Use of 'white space': 'White space' on a page i.e. space filled only with the background color should be used in such a way that it does not impair the visual skimming of the page. While white space is an important means of visually organizing the different content elements on a page, if the distance between the blocks of information displayed becomes too large, rapid skimming of the page can be impeded.

availableConstraints.description: 页面长度应根据页面的主要目的和使用情况选择
availableConstraints.sourceText: Selecting appropriate page lengths The length of a page should be selected so as to support the primary purpose and use of the page. Short pages are generally more appropriate for homepages, navigation pages, or overview pages that need to be read quickly. Longer pages can be more appropriate when users want to read the content without interruptions or when the page needs to match a paper counterpart.

availableConstraints.description: 应谨慎使用颜色，不作为传达信息的唯一手段
availableConstraints.sourceText: Using colour: Colour should be used with care, taking into account human capabilities and restrictions in perceiving colour, and not as the only means of conveying information. Color should never be the only means of coding. Some users may have difficulties in perceiving certain colors or color combinations (color-blindness).

availableConstraints.description: 如果使用框架，应避免可能的问题并提供无框架的替代方案
availableConstraints.sourceText: Using frames with care: If frames are used, care should be taken to avoid possible problems, for example, those involving the use of the back button, bookmarking of pages, or scrolling of information. When frames are used, it is important to title each frame, and to describe its purpose and how frames relate to one another other. Providing alternatives to frame-based presentation: If frames are used, an alternative way of presenting relevant information without frames should be provided. Providing alternative text-only pages: When style sheets and/or frames are turned off it should be possible for the user to read and understand the page; alternatively, the user should be provided with an equivalent alternative text-only page.

availableConstraints.description: 页面应使用一致的布局方案设计
availableConstraints.sourceText: Consistent page layout: Pages should be designed using consistent layout schemes, supporting the user in finding similar information at the same position on different pages. Overall layout schemes apply to all pages and are preferable when all pages have a similar structure. Frequently, however, different pages have different purposes and types of content. In such cases, pages can usually be grouped in different categories, using one layout scheme for each category consistently.

availableConstraints.description: 页面标题应放置在不同页面上的一致位置
availableConstraints.sourceText: Placing title information consistently: Page titles should be placed in a consistent location on the different pages.

availableConstraints.description: 设计应用程序页面时应考虑人类感知的一般原则
availableConstraints.sourceText: Observing principles of human perception When designing application pages, the general principles of human perception should be taken into account. The International Standards mentioned below shall be consulted for guidance. Practical guidelines for presenting information to the user are to be found in ISO 9241-12. Guidance on selecting and using different forms of interaction techniques is to be found in ISO 9241-14 to ISO 9241-17. ISO 9241-14 gives guidance about menus, ISO 9241-15 about command dialogues, ISO 9241-16 about direct manipulation and ISO 9241-17 about forms. In addition, when designing multimedia information presentations, the design principles and recommendations described in ISO 14915-1 to ISO 14915-3 should be taken into account. Appropriate content presentation also plays a key role in accessibility.

availableConstraints.description: 每个页面应包含指向应用程序主页或地标页面的链接
availableConstraints.sourceText: Linking back to the home page or landmark pages: Each page should contain a link leading to the home page of the application or to a landmark page that is easy to recognize for the user.

availableConstraints.description: 应提供显示站点结构的单独导航概览（如站点地图）
availableConstraints.sourceText: Providing a site map: A separate navigation overview such as a site map should be provided for application showing the structure of the site in an overview form.

availableConstraints.description: 如果显示导航组件，应通过突出显示保持与内容的当前主题一致
availableConstraints.sourceText: Consistency between navigation components and content: If navigation components (or overviews) are shown in conjunction with associated content, consistency between the navigation component and the content shown should be maintained by indicating in the navigation component (e.g. highlighting) the topic currently visible in the content area.

availableConstraints.description: 导航组件应一致地放置在页面或框架集中
availableConstraints.sourceText: Placing navigation components consistently: Navigation components should be placed consistently on the pages or in the framesets in the pages of the application.

availableConstraints.description: 应使个体化和/或适应对用户明显
availableConstraints.sourceText: Making individualization and adaptation evident: It should be made evident to the user when individualization and/or adaptation are used.

availableConstraints.description: 如果使用用户配置文件，当前使用的配置文件应明显
availableConstraints.sourceText: Making user profiles evident: If predefined user profiles or user-specified profiles are used for individualizing or adapting content, the profile currently used should be made evident. If profiles are used, it is important to provide users with information about this concept and its implications.

availableConstraints.description: 如果使用用户指定的配置文件，用户应能够查看、修改和删除该配置文件
availableConstraints.sourceText: Allowing users to see and change profiles: If user-specified profiles are used, users should be able to see, modify and delete that profile on demand.

availableConstraints.description: 系统用户界面应遵循www.usability.gov指定的指南
availableConstraints.sourceText: The user interfaces of the system should follow the guidelines specified under www.usability.gov

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须在指定时间内对用户可用
availableConstraints.sourceText: from <xx:00> to <xx:00>; on <all weekdays/xxx days per year>. The System must be available to users:

availableConstraints.description: 系统的计划停机时间不得超过每三个月滚动周期<xx>小时
availableConstraints.sourceText: The planned downtime for the System must not exceed <xx> hours per <rolling three month period>. The System is considered to be down if any user is unable to perform any normal System function and if this failure is attributed to any component of the System other than the workstation.

availableConstraints.description: 系统的非计划停机时间不得超过每三个月滚动周期<xx小时/分钟>
availableConstraints.sourceText: Unplanned downtime for the System must not exceed <xx hours/minutes> per <rolling three month period>.

availableConstraints.description: 系统的非计划停机事件数量不得超过每三个月滚动周期<x>次
availableConstraints.sourceText: The number of incidents of unplanned downtime for the System must not exceed <x> per <rolling three month period>.

availableConstraints.description: 在任何软件或硬件故障情况下，系统必须能够在不超过<xx>小时内恢复（带在线同步）
availableConstraints.sourceText: In the event of any software or hardware failure, it must be possible to restore the System (with inline synchronization) within no more than <xx> hours.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须为常用功能在标准和峰值条件下提供足够的响应时间
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must provide adequate response times for commonly performed functions under both standard and peak conditions

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为在低带宽连接的警察局也能有满意的性能
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed to have satisfactory performance even in Police Stations connected on low-bandwidth

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用面向服务的架构(SOA)实现并具有模块化设计
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be implemented using Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and have a modular design

availableConstraints.description: 系统应基于开放标准开发
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be developed on Open Standards

availableConstraints.description: 系统应构建在通用用户访问和认证服务上，确保最终用户的单点登录
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be built on a common User Access and Authentication Service to ensure Single-Sign on for the end-user

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为集中部署和维护
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be developed for a centralized deployment and maintenance

availableConstraints.description: 系统应开发为部署在三层数据中心架构中
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be developed to be deployed in a 3-tier datacenter architecture

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为具有n层架构，表示逻辑与业务逻辑分离，业务逻辑又与数据访问逻辑分离
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed to have a n-tier architecture with the presentation logic separated from the business logic that is again separated from the data-access logic

availableConstraints.description: 系统应可扩展以通过PDA和移动数据终端提供对接口的访问
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be extensible to provide access to the interfaces through PDA's and mobile data terminals

availableConstraints.description: 系统应采用标准化格式和通用元数据元素
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should adopt standardized formats and common metadata elements

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为通过基于浏览器的系统访问，并对客户端设备要求最低
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed for access through browser-based systems and must impose minimal requirements on the client device

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须支持多种类型的远程访问通信服务
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system must support multiple types of communication services for remote access

availableConstraints.description: 系统应能够支持对数据子集和功能的公共访问
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should have capability to support public access to a subset of data and functionality

availableConstraints.description: 系统应在需要时支持多层认证
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support multi-tier authentication where required

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持SSL加密连接
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support SSL encrypted connections

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持安全虚拟专用网络连接
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support secure virtual private network connections

availableConstraints.description: 系统应在多个浏览器上运行
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should run on multiple browsers

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用AJAX技术改善用户体验
availableConstraints.sourceText: Use of AJAX based technology to improve user experience.

availableConstraints.description: 应根据屏幕和估计使用模式考虑积极页面加载
availableConstraints.sourceText: Aggressive page loading to be considered based on the screen and estimate usage pattern

availableConstraints.description: 应利用Web服务器的异步HTTP套接字功能实现可扩展性和性能
availableConstraints.sourceText: Leverage Asynchronous HTTP socket capabilities of web server for scalability and performance

availableConstraints.description: 所有静态内容（文档、图像）应托管在Web服务器上
availableConstraints.sourceText: Host all the static content (documents, images) on the web server

availableConstraints.description: 记录应在屏幕上以批次/分页方式显示
availableConstraints.sourceText: Display of records on the screen in batches/paged manner

availableConstraints.description: 应配置和使用分层缓存来缓存最频繁使用的搜索结果
availableConstraints.sourceText: A hierarchical cache should be configured and used for caching of results of most frequently used searches

tasks.description: 需求分析：案件调查模块

contextHints.note: 提取案件调查相关的实体和功能

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须为所有用户界面上的所有可能操作和场景提供详细的上下文相关帮助材料
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供界面让用户记录应用程序中的任何缺陷或增强请求并跟踪
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够向用户发送警报（如电子邮件、短信），当用户选择时，每当对警报采取任何行动时
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should send alerts (e.g., email, SMS) to the user if the user chooses to whenever any action has been taken on the alert.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够维护不可更改的审计跟踪，自动捕获和存储关键实体的操作信息
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word 'unalterable' is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

availableConstraints.description: 审计跟踪功能激活后，系统必须无需人工干预跟踪事件并存储审计跟踪信息
availableConstraints.sourceText: Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须维护审计跟踪至少与相关案件的寿命一样长
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must maintain the audit trail for as long as required, which will be at least for the life of the case to which it refers.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须确保审计跟踪数据在请求时可被检查
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够导出指定案件的审计跟踪（不影响系统存储的审计跟踪）
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to export audit trails for specified cases (without affecting the audit trail stored by the System). This functionality can be used by external auditors who wish to examine or analyse system activity.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够捕获和存储访问控制机制的违规和尝试违规
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to capture and store violations (i.e. A user's attempts to access a case to which he is denied access), and (where violations can validly be attempted) attempted violations, of access control mechanisms.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许用户将案件访问限制为指定用户或用户组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应提供基于角色的功能控制
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should provide for role-based control for the functionality within the system

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许用户成为多个组的成员
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow a user to be a member of more than one group.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须仅允许管理员用户设置用户配置文件并将用户分配到组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须仅允许超级用户更改组或用户的安全属性
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow changes to security attributes for groups or users (such as access rights, security level, privileges, password allocation and management) to be made only by super-user.

availableConstraints.description: 如果用户请求访问或搜索他们没有权限访问的案件，系统必须提供可配置的响应选项
availableConstraints.sourceText: If a user requests access to, or searches for, a case which he does not have the right to access, the System must provide one of the following responses (selectable at configuration time):These options are presented in order of increasing security. Note that the requirement in the third option (i.e. the most stringent) implies that the System must not include such cases in any count of search results; this level of security is normally appropriate for cases dealing with matters such as national security.

availableConstraints.description: 系统在搜索结果列表中绝不能包含用户无权访问的任何记录
availableConstraints.sourceText: If a user performs a quick or advanced search, the System must never include in the search result list any record which the user does not have the right to access.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须记录用户对案件的无权访问尝试到审计跟踪中
availableConstraints.sourceText: If the System allows users to make unauthorised attempts to access cases, it must log these in the audit trail.

availableConstraints.description: 系统产生的所有错误消息必须是有意义的
availableConstraints.sourceText: All error messages produced by the System must be meaningful, so that they can be appropriately acted upon by the users who are likely to see them. Ideally, each error message will be accompanied by explanatory text and an indication of the action(s) which the user can take in response to the error.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须采用单一的用户界面规则集，提供熟悉和共同的外观和感觉
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must employ a single set of user interface rules, or a small number of sets to provide a familiar and common look and feel for the application.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够同时显示多个实体（案件、嫌疑人）
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to display several entities (cases, suspects) simultaneously.

availableConstraints.description: 界面必须尽可能可定制或用户可配置，并将配置保存在用户配置文件中
availableConstraints.sourceText: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

availableConstraints.description: 系统用户界面必须适合有特殊需求的用户
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System user interface must be suitable for users with special needs; that is, compatible with specialist software that may be used and with appropriate interface guidelines

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够在5-8秒内执行简单搜索，在10-15秒内执行高级搜索
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够在5-8秒内检索并显示过去2个月内访问过的案件
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for rapid retrieval of frequently-used cases, on the understanding that frequency of use is typically correlated with recent use.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够在20秒内检索并显示过去2个月内未访问过的案件
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for cases where cases used infrequently are stored on slower media than more active records.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须可扩展，不能有任何功能会妨碍在不同规模的警察局使用
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System be scaleable and must not have any features which would preclude use in small or large police stations, with varying numbers of cases handled.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持多语言界面
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support multilingual interface

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为在设备或通信网络故障时不会丢失操作数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed in manner that operational data is not lost in case of any failure of equipment or communication network.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持HTTPS作为通信协议
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should use HTTPS as the communication protocol, i.e., HTTP over an encrypted secure socket layer (SSL)

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持选择性加密存储数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support selective encryption of the stored data

availableConstraints.description: 系统应确保通过网络安全传输数据，使用SSL和双向数字签名
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should ensure secure transmission of data over the network and utilize SSL and 2-way digital signatures

availableConstraints.description: 系统应防止跨站脚本攻击
availableConstraints.sourceText: Prevent cross-site scripting

availableConstraints.description: 系统应防止SQL注入
availableConstraints.sourceText: Prevent SQL Injection

availableConstraints.description: 系统不应允许硬删除，只应执行软标记行以进行删除
availableConstraints.sourceText: Do not allow hard delete and perform only soft tagging the row for deletion

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用缓存存储频繁使用的数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: Use of cache for storing frequent data

availableConstraints.description: 搜索结果应从数据库中以10或20个为一批获取
availableConstraints.sourceText: The search results should be fetched from the database in batches of 10 or 20 maximum as configured within the application

availableConstraints.description: 搜索应仅获取需要显示给用户的字段
availableConstraints.sourceText: The search should fetch only the fields that need to be displayed to the user. Only when the user clicks on a particular record to view its further details should a query be fired to fetch the additional details for this particular record only

availableConstraints.description: 应在用于搜索的关键列上应用数据库索引
availableConstraints.sourceText: Database Indexes should be applied on the key columns used for searching

availableConstraints.description: 系统用户界面应符合ISO 9241标准
availableConstraints.sourceText: The user interfaces of the system should comply with Standard ISO 9241.

availableConstraints.description: 应用程序徽标应作为主页链接在所有页面上可用
availableConstraints.sourceText: The application logo to be available on all pages as a link to the home page.

availableConstraints.description: 所有非文本媒体对象应提供等效的文本描述
availableConstraints.sourceText: All non-text media objects, such as graphical images or video, should be provided with alternative equivalent textual descriptions and/or with equivalent text-based functionality.

availableConstraints.description: 导航应设计为帮助用户理解他们在哪里、去过哪里以及下一步可以去哪里
availableConstraints.sourceText: Navigation should be designed to help users understand where they are, where they have been and where they can go next. General guidance on achieving self-descriptiveness is given in ISO 9241-110.

availableConstraints.description: 每个呈现段应提供用户在导航结构中位置的清晰指示
availableConstraints.sourceText: Each presentation segment (page or window) should provide the user with a clear and sufficient indication of where he or she is in the navigation structure and of the current segment position with respect to the overall structure.

availableConstraints.description: 应提供替代访问路径以支持不同的导航策略
availableConstraints.sourceText: Alternative access paths for navigating to a specific unit of content should be offered to support different navigation strategies.

availableConstraints.description: 应尽量减少到达特定内容所需的导航步骤
availableConstraints.sourceText: The number of navigation steps needed to reach a certain piece of content should be minimized as long as different mental models, navigation strategies and tasks of the user are taken into account.

availableConstraints.description: 除非提供有用的内容或反馈，否则应避免使用启动画面
availableConstraints.sourceText: Splash screens should be avoided unless they provide useful content or feedback about the application state to the user. If a splash screen is used, a navigation option to skip it should be offered.

availableConstraints.description: 除非支持用户任务，否则应避免打开不必要的窗口
availableConstraints.sourceText: Additional windows such as new browser windows or pop-up windows should only be opened if this supports the user's task. Opening new windows can distract, confuse or impede users for a variety of reasons. They can superimpose the primary window, hiding relevant information. They could make it cognitively more difficult to understand the navigation structure with negative effects on both usability and accessibility. They also require additional user actions for closing unwanted windows.

availableConstraints.description: 应尽量减少垂直滚动，尽可能避免水平滚动
availableConstraints.sourceText: Vertical scrolling should be minimized. This may be done by placing important information at the top and providing links to information that is further down the page. Horizontal scrolling should be avoided wherever possible.

availableConstraints.description: 用户界面应设计为允许通过各种输入设备激活控件
availableConstraints.sourceText: User interfaces should be designed to allow activation of controls by a variety of input devices. The ability to choose between different input devices for activating controls such as links, fields and buttons is important both for users who prefer a certain input mode, mobile users and users with disabilities. In general, device independence can be achieved if the functionality is operable via a keyboard.

availableConstraints.description: 用户界面应设计为尽可能健壮以应对技术变化
availableConstraints.sourceText: Making user interfaces robust: User interfaces should be designed to be as robust as possible in the face of changing technology. This encompasses being able to present content containing newer technologies by older user agents as well as designing content to be usable with future technologies.

availableConstraints.description: 应用程序页面应设计为在预期技术使用环境下有可接受的打开和下载时间
availableConstraints.sourceText: Application pages should be designed and implemented so that there are acceptable opening times and download times for the expected range of technical contexts of use (e.g. bandwidth between the application and the user). This is particularly important for frequently accessed pages or pages that are important for user navigation and exploration, such as the home page.

availableConstraints.description: 应尽量减少潜在用户错误和从错误中恢复所需的努力
availableConstraints.sourceText: Minimizing user errors: Potential user errors as well as the effort needed to recover from errors should be minimized.

availableConstraints.description: 错误消息应清楚地说明错误原因和可能的解决操作
availableConstraints.sourceText: Providing clear error messages: The content of error messages shown on the pages or special error pages should clearly state the reason why the error occurred and, if possible, actions the user can take to resolve the error. Users expect error messages to be in the same language as the user interface.

availableConstraints.description: 用户应能够调整文本大小
availableConstraints.sourceText: Making text resizable by the user: Text should be able to be resized by the user, using functions provided by the user agent or other appropriate means i.e. see ISO 9241-171.

availableConstraints.description: 文本内容的质量在拼写和语法方面应足够不影响可读性
availableConstraints.sourceText: Text quality: The quality of textual content with respect to spelling and grammar should be sufficient so as not to impede readability.

availableConstraints.description: 应支持快速浏览文本，通过提供清晰的链接、项目符号列表等
availableConstraints.sourceText: Supporting text skimming: Fast skimming of text should be supported by the provision of clear links, bulleted lists, highlighted keywords, logical headings, and short phrases and sentences.

availableConstraints.description: 页面内链接应与其他链接明显区分
availableConstraints.sourceText: Distinguishable within-page links: Within-page links should be clearly distinguishable from other links that lead to a different page. EX. Within-page links are shown with dashed rather than solid underlines

availableConstraints.description: 应避免链接过载，以免影响文本可读性
availableConstraints.sourceText: Avoiding link overload: Text pages containing large proportions of links should be formatted so that the presence of links does not impede the readability of the text.

availableConstraints.description: 导航链接应使用用户熟悉的术语标记
availableConstraints.sourceText: Using familiar terminology for navigation links: Navigation links — particularly links representing the main navigation structure — should be labelled with terms that are familiar to the user, based on his/her general knowledge, prior experience in the application domain or experience of using other systems.

availableConstraints.description: 链接标签应描述性地指示其目标或目的
availableConstraints.sourceText: Using descriptive link labels: The target or purpose of a link should be directly indicated by its label, avoiding generic labels such as 'go' or 'click here' except where the purpose of the link is clear from its context on the page or the labels have commonly understood semantics in the particular application domain. Using appropriate terminology specific to the user's tasks and information needs is important for making the content easy to understand.

availableConstraints.description: 打开新窗口的链接应明确标记
availableConstraints.sourceText: Marking links opening new windows: Links that open new browser windows or pop-up windows should be clearly marked.

availableConstraints.description: 导航链接应与操作控件明显区分
availableConstraints.sourceText: Distinguishing navigation links from controls: Navigation links should be clearly distinguishable from controls activating some action. Typical action types in user interfaces include manipulating application data, performing searches, communication actions, such as opening a new e-mail window or starting a chat function, and presentation-related actions, such as sorting a list of search results.

availableConstraints.description: 如果文档太长或布局不适合在线阅读，应提供可打印版本
availableConstraints.sourceText: Providing printable document versions: If a document is either too long, dispersed over several pages or in a specific layout that is not suitable for online reading, a printer-friendly version of the document should be provided that prints the content in a form acceptable to the user (e.g. in the expected layout, paper format, or orientation).

availableConstraints.description: 应谨慎使用空白，不影响页面的视觉浏览
availableConstraints.sourceText: Use of 'white space': 'White space' on a page i.e. space filled only with the background color should be used in such a way that it does not impair the visual skimming of the page. While white space is an important means of visually organizing the different content elements on a page, if the distance between the blocks of information displayed becomes too large, rapid skimming of the page can be impeded.

availableConstraints.description: 页面长度应根据页面的主要目的和使用情况选择
availableConstraints.sourceText: Selecting appropriate page lengths The length of a page should be selected so as to support the primary purpose and use of the page. Short pages are generally more appropriate for homepages, navigation pages, or overview pages that need to be read quickly. Longer pages can be more appropriate when users want to read the content without interruptions or when the page needs to match a paper counterpart.

availableConstraints.description: 应谨慎使用颜色，不作为传达信息的唯一手段
availableConstraints.sourceText: Using colour: Colour should be used with care, taking into account human capabilities and restrictions in perceiving colour, and not as the only means of conveying information. Color should never be the only means of coding. Some users may have difficulties in perceiving certain colors or color combinations (color-blindness).

availableConstraints.description: 如果使用框架，应避免可能的问题并提供无框架的替代方案
availableConstraints.sourceText: Using frames with care: If frames are used, care should be taken to avoid possible problems, for example, those involving the use of the back button, bookmarking of pages, or scrolling of information. When frames are used, it is important to title each frame, and to describe its purpose and how frames relate to one another other. Providing alternatives to frame-based presentation: If frames are used, an alternative way of presenting relevant information without frames should be provided. Providing alternative text-only pages: When style sheets and/or frames are turned off it should be possible for the user to read and understand the page; alternatively, the user should be provided with an equivalent alternative text-only page.

availableConstraints.description: 页面应使用一致的布局方案设计
availableConstraints.sourceText: Consistent page layout: Pages should be designed using consistent layout schemes, supporting the user in finding similar information at the same position on different pages. Overall layout schemes apply to all pages and are preferable when all pages have a similar structure. Frequently, however, different pages have different purposes and types of content. In such cases, pages can usually be grouped in different categories, using one layout scheme for each category consistently.

availableConstraints.description: 页面标题应放置在不同页面上的一致位置
availableConstraints.sourceText: Placing title information consistently: Page titles should be placed in a consistent location on the different pages.

availableConstraints.description: 设计应用程序页面时应考虑人类感知的一般原则
availableConstraints.sourceText: Observing principles of human perception When designing application pages, the general principles of human perception should be taken into account. The International Standards mentioned below shall be consulted for guidance. Practical guidelines for presenting information to the user are to be found in ISO 9241-12. Guidance on selecting and using different forms of interaction techniques is to be found in ISO 9241-14 to ISO 9241-17. ISO 9241-14 gives guidance about menus, ISO 9241-15 about command dialogues, ISO 9241-16 about direct manipulation and ISO 9241-17 about forms. In addition, when designing multimedia information presentations, the design principles and recommendations described in ISO 14915-1 to ISO 14915-3 should be taken into account. Appropriate content presentation also plays a key role in accessibility.

availableConstraints.description: 每个页面应包含指向应用程序主页或地标页面的链接
availableConstraints.sourceText: Linking back to the home page or landmark pages: Each page should contain a link leading to the home page of the application or to a landmark page that is easy to recognize for the user.

availableConstraints.description: 应提供显示站点结构的单独导航概览（如站点地图）
availableConstraints.sourceText: Providing a site map: A separate navigation overview such as a site map should be provided for application showing the structure of the site in an overview form.

availableConstraints.description: 如果显示导航组件，应通过突出显示保持与内容的当前主题一致
availableConstraints.sourceText: Consistency between navigation components and content: If navigation components (or overviews) are shown in conjunction with associated content, consistency between the navigation component and the content shown should be maintained by indicating in the navigation component (e.g. highlighting) the topic currently visible in the content area.

availableConstraints.description: 导航组件应一致地放置在页面或框架集中
availableConstraints.sourceText: Placing navigation components consistently: Navigation components should be placed consistently on the pages or in the framesets in the pages of the application.

availableConstraints.description: 应使个体化和/或适应对用户明显
availableConstraints.sourceText: Making individualization and adaptation evident: It should be made evident to the user when individualization and/or adaptation are used.

availableConstraints.description: 如果使用用户配置文件，当前使用的配置文件应明显
availableConstraints.sourceText: Making user profiles evident: If predefined user profiles or user-specified profiles are used for individualizing or adapting content, the profile currently used should be made evident. If profiles are used, it is important to provide users with information about this concept and its implications.

availableConstraints.description: 如果使用用户指定的配置文件，用户应能够查看、修改和删除该配置文件
availableConstraints.sourceText: Allowing users to see and change profiles: If user-specified profiles are used, users should be able to see, modify and delete that profile on demand.

availableConstraints.description: 系统用户界面应遵循www.usability.gov指定的指南
availableConstraints.sourceText: The user interfaces of the system should follow the guidelines specified under www.usability.gov

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须在指定时间内对用户可用
availableConstraints.sourceText: from <xx:00> to <xx:00>; on <all weekdays/xxx days per year>. The System must be available to users:

availableConstraints.description: 系统的计划停机时间不得超过每三个月滚动周期<xx>小时
availableConstraints.sourceText: The planned downtime for the System must not exceed <xx> hours per <rolling three month period>. The System is considered to be down if any user is unable to perform any normal System function and if this failure is attributed to any component of the System other than the workstation.

availableConstraints.description: 系统的非计划停机时间不得超过每三个月滚动周期<xx小时/分钟>
availableConstraints.sourceText: Unplanned downtime for the System must not exceed <xx hours/minutes> per <rolling three month period>.

availableConstraints.description: 系统的非计划停机事件数量不得超过每三个月滚动周期<x>次
availableConstraints.sourceText: The number of incidents of unplanned downtime for the System must not exceed <x> per <rolling three month period>.

availableConstraints.description: 在任何软件或硬件故障情况下，系统必须能够在不超过<xx>小时内恢复（带在线同步）
availableConstraints.sourceText: In the event of any software or hardware failure, it must be possible to restore the System (with inline synchronization) within no more than <xx> hours.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须为常用功能在标准和峰值条件下提供足够的响应时间
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must provide adequate response times for commonly performed functions under both standard and peak conditions

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为在低带宽连接的警察局也能有满意的性能
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed to have satisfactory performance even in Police Stations connected on low-bandwidth

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用面向服务的架构(SOA)实现并具有模块化设计
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be implemented using Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) and have a modular design

availableConstraints.description: 系统应基于开放标准开发
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be developed on Open Standards

availableConstraints.description: 系统应构建在通用用户访问和认证服务上，确保最终用户的单点登录
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be built on a common User Access and Authentication Service to ensure Single-Sign on for the end-user

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为集中部署和维护
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be developed for a centralized deployment and maintenance

availableConstraints.description: 系统应开发为部署在三层数据中心架构中
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be developed to be deployed in a 3-tier datacenter architecture

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为具有n层架构，表示逻辑与业务逻辑分离，业务逻辑又与数据访问逻辑分离
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed to have a n-tier architecture with the presentation logic separated from the business logic that is again separated from the data-access logic

availableConstraints.description: 系统应可扩展以通过PDA和移动数据终端提供对接口的访问
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be extensible to provide access to the interfaces through PDA's and mobile data terminals

availableConstraints.description: 系统应采用标准化格式和通用元数据元素
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should adopt standardized formats and common metadata elements

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为通过基于浏览器的系统访问，并对客户端设备要求最低
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed for access through browser-based systems and must impose minimal requirements on the client device

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须支持多种类型的远程访问通信服务
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system must support multiple types of communication services for remote access

availableConstraints.description: 系统应能够支持对数据子集和功能的公共访问
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should have capability to support public access to a subset of data and functionality

availableConstraints.description: 系统应在需要时支持多层认证
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support multi-tier authentication where required

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持SSL加密连接
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support SSL encrypted connections

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持安全虚拟专用网络连接
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support secure virtual private network connections

availableConstraints.description: 系统应在多个浏览器上运行
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should run on multiple browsers

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用AJAX技术改善用户体验
availableConstraints.sourceText: Use of AJAX based technology to improve user experience.

availableConstraints.description: 应根据屏幕和估计使用模式考虑积极页面加载
availableConstraints.sourceText: Aggressive page loading to be considered based on the screen and estimate usage pattern

availableConstraints.description: 应利用Web服务器的异步HTTP套接字功能实现可扩展性和性能
availableConstraints.sourceText: Leverage Asynchronous HTTP socket capabilities of web server for scalability and performance

availableConstraints.description: 所有静态内容（文档、图像）应托管在Web服务器上
availableConstraints.sourceText: Host all the static content (documents, images) on the web server

availableConstraints.description: 记录应在屏幕上以批次/分页方式显示
availableConstraints.sourceText: Display of records on the screen in batches/paged manner

availableConstraints.description: 应配置和使用分层缓存来缓存最频繁使用的搜索结果
availableConstraints.sourceText: A hierarchical cache should be configured and used for caching of results of most frequently used searches

tasks.description: 需求分析：案件起诉模块

contextHints.note: 提取案件起诉相关的实体和功能

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须为所有用户界面上的所有可能操作和场景提供详细的上下文相关帮助材料
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should provide detailed context-sensitive help material for all the possible actions and scenarios on all user interfaces in the application.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须提供界面让用户记录应用程序中的任何缺陷或增强请求并跟踪
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should provide an interface for the user to log any defects or enhancement requests on the application and track thereafter.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够向用户发送警报（如电子邮件、短信），当用户选择时，每当对警报采取任何行动时
availableConstraints.sourceText: The solution should send alerts (e.g., email, SMS) to the user if the user chooses to whenever any action has been taken on the alert.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够维护不可更改的审计跟踪，自动捕获和存储关键实体的操作信息
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must keep an unalterable audit trail capable of automatically capturing and storing information about:The word 'unalterable' is to mean that the audit trail data cannot be modified in any way or deleted by any user; it may be subject to re-department and copying to removable media if required, so long as its contents remain unchanged.

availableConstraints.description: 审计跟踪功能激活后，系统必须无需人工干预跟踪事件并存储审计跟踪信息
availableConstraints.sourceText: Once the audit trail functionality has been activated, the System must track events without manual intervention, and store in the audit trail information about them.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须维护审计跟踪至少与相关案件的寿命一样长
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must maintain the audit trail for as long as required, which will be at least for the life of the case to which it refers.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须确保审计跟踪数据在请求时可被检查
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must ensure that audit trail data is available for inspection on request, so that a specific event can be identified and all related data made accessible, and that this can be achieved by authorised external personnel who have little or no familiarity with the system.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够导出指定案件的审计跟踪（不影响系统存储的审计跟踪）
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to export audit trails for specified cases (without affecting the audit trail stored by the System). This functionality can be used by external auditors who wish to examine or analyse system activity.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够捕获和存储访问控制机制的违规和尝试违规
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to capture and store violations (i.e. A user's attempts to access a case to which he is denied access), and (where violations can validly be attempted) attempted violations, of access control mechanisms.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许用户将案件访问限制为指定用户或用户组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow the user to limit access to cases to specified users or user groups.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应提供基于角色的功能控制
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should provide for role-based control for the functionality within the system

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须允许用户成为多个组的成员
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow a user to be a member of more than one group.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须仅允许管理员用户设置用户配置文件并将用户分配到组
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow only admin-users to set up user profiles and allocate users to groups.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须仅允许超级用户更改组或用户的安全属性
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must allow changes to security attributes for groups or users (such as access rights, security level, privileges, password allocation and management) to be made only by super-user.

availableConstraints.description: 如果用户请求访问或搜索他们没有权限访问的案件，系统必须提供可配置的响应选项
availableConstraints.sourceText: If a user requests access to, or searches for, a case which he does not have the right to access, the System must provide one of the following responses (selectable at configuration time):These options are presented in order of increasing security. Note that the requirement in the third option (i.e. the most stringent) implies that the System must not include such cases in any count of search results; this level of security is normally appropriate for cases dealing with matters such as national security.

availableConstraints.description: 系统在搜索结果列表中绝不能包含用户无权访问的任何记录
availableConstraints.sourceText: If a user performs a quick or advanced search, the System must never include in the search result list any record which the user does not have the right to access.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须记录用户对案件的无权访问尝试到审计跟踪中
availableConstraints.sourceText: If the System allows users to make unauthorised attempts to access cases, it must log these in the audit trail.

availableConstraints.description: 系统产生的所有错误消息必须是有意义的
availableConstraints.sourceText: All error messages produced by the System must be meaningful, so that they can be appropriately acted upon by the users who are likely to see them. Ideally, each error message will be accompanied by explanatory text and an indication of the action(s) which the user can take in response to the error.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须采用单一的用户界面规则集，提供熟悉和共同的外观和感觉
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must employ a single set of user interface rules, or a small number of sets to provide a familiar and common look and feel for the application.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够同时显示多个实体（案件、嫌疑人）
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to display several entities (cases, suspects) simultaneously.

availableConstraints.description: 界面必须尽可能可定制或用户可配置，并将配置保存在用户配置文件中
availableConstraints.sourceText: The interfaces must be made customizable or user-configurable to the extent possible. (e.g., the displayed columns in the table, move, resize, modify the appearance). Such configurations must be saved in the user profile.

availableConstraints.description: 系统用户界面必须适合有特殊需求的用户
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System user interface must be suitable for users with special needs; that is, compatible with specialist software that may be used and with appropriate interface guidelines

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够在5-8秒内执行简单搜索，在10-15秒内执行高级搜索
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system. In this context, performing a search means returning a result list. It does not include retrieving the records themselves.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够在5-8秒内检索并显示过去2个月内访问过的案件
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for rapid retrieval of frequently-used cases, on the understanding that frequency of use is typically correlated with recent use.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须能够在20秒内检索并显示过去2个月内未访问过的案件
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system. This requirement is intended to allow for cases where cases used infrequently are stored on slower media than more active records.

availableConstraints.description: 系统必须可扩展，不能有任何功能会妨碍在不同规模的警察局使用
availableConstraints.sourceText: The System be scaleable and must not have any features which would preclude use in small or large police stations, with varying numbers of cases handled.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持多语言界面
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support multilingual interface

availableConstraints.description: 系统应设计为在设备或通信网络故障时不会丢失操作数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should be designed in manner that operational data is not lost in case of any failure of equipment or communication network.

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持HTTPS作为通信协议
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should use HTTPS as the communication protocol, i.e., HTTP over an encrypted secure socket layer (SSL)

availableConstraints.description: 系统应支持选择性加密存储数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should support selective encryption of the stored data

availableConstraints.description: 系统应确保通过网络安全传输数据，使用SSL和双向数字签名
availableConstraints.sourceText: The system should ensure secure transmission of data over the network and utilize SSL and 2-way digital signatures

availableConstraints.description: 系统应防止跨站脚本攻击
availableConstraints.sourceText: Prevent cross-site scripting

availableConstraints.description: 系统应防止SQL注入
availableConstraints.sourceText: Prevent SQL Injection

availableConstraints.description: 系统不应允许硬删除，只应执行软标记行以进行删除
availableConstraints.sourceText: Do not allow hard delete and perform only soft tagging the row for deletion

availableConstraints.description: 系统应使用缓存存储频繁使用的数据
availableConstraints.sourceText: Use of cache for storing frequent data

availableConstraints.description: 搜索结果应从数据库中以10或20个为一批获取
availableConstraints.sourceText: The search results should be fetched from the database in batches of 10 or 20 maximum as configured within the application

availableConstraints.description: 搜索应仅获取需要显示给用户的字段
availableConstraints.sourceText: The search should fetch only the fields that need to be displayed to the user. Only when the user clicks on a particular record to view its further details should a query be fired to fetch the additional details for this particular record only

availableConstraints.description: 应在用于搜索的关键列上应用数据库索引
availableConstraints.sourceText: Database Indexes should be applied on the key columns used for searching

availableConstraints.description: 系统用户界面应符合ISO 9241标准
availableConstraints.sourceText: The user interfaces of the system should comply with Standard ISO 9241.

availableConstraints.description: 应用程序徽标应作为主页链接在所有页面上可用
availableConstraints.sourceText: The application logo to be available on all pages as a link to the home page.

availableConstraints.description: 所有非文本媒体对象应提供等效的文本描述
availableConstraints.sourceText: All non-text media objects, such as graphical images or video, should be provided with alternative equivalent textual descriptions and/or with equivalent text-based functionality.

availableConstraints.description: 导航应设计为帮助用户理解他们在哪里、去过哪里以及下一步可以去哪里
availableConstraints.sourceText: Navigation should be designed to help users understand where they are, where they have been and where they can go next. General guidance on achieving self-descriptiveness is given in ISO 9241-110.

availableConstraints.description: 每个呈现段应提供用户在导航结构中位置的清晰指示
availableConstraints.sourceText: Each presentation segment (page or window) should provide the user with a clear and sufficient indication of where he or she is in the navigation structure and of the current segment position with respect to the overall structure.

availableConstraints.description: 应提供替代访问路径以支持不同的导航策略
availableConstraints.sourceText: Alternative access paths for navigating to a specific unit of content should be offered to support different navigation strategies.

availableConstraints.description: 应尽量减少到达特定内容所需的导航步骤
availableConstraints.sourceText: The number of navigation steps needed to reach a certain piece of content should be minimized as long as different mental models, navigation strategies and tasks of the user are taken into account.

availableConstraints.description: 除非提供有用的内容或反馈，否则应避免使用启动画面
availableConstraints.sourceText: Splash screens should be avoided unless they provide useful content or feedback about the application state to the user. If a splash screen is used, a navigation option to skip it should be offered.

availableConstraints.description: 除非支持用户任务，否则应避免打开不必要的窗口
availableConstraints.sourceText: Additional windows such as new browser windows or pop-up windows should only be opened if this supports the user's task. Opening new windows can distract, confuse or impede users for a variety of reasons. They can superimpose the primary window, hiding relevant information. They could make it cognitively more difficult to understand the navigation structure with negative effects on both usability and accessibility. They also require additional user actions for closing unwanted windows.

availableConstraints.description: 应尽量减少垂直滚动，尽可能避免水平滚动
availableConstraints.sourceText: Vertical scrolling should be minimized. This may be done by placing important information at the top and providing links to information that is further down the page. Horizontal scrolling should be avoided wherever possible.

availableConstraints.description: 用户界面应设计为允许通过各种输入设备激活控件
availableConstraints.sourceText: User interfaces should be designed to allow activation of controls by a variety of input devices. The ability to choose between different input devices for activating controls such as links, fields and buttons is important both for users who prefer a certain input mode, mobile users and users with disabilities. In general, device independence can be achieved if the functionality is operable via a keyboard.

availableConstraints.description: 用户界面应设计为尽可能健壮以应对技术变化
availableConstraints.sourceText: Making user interfaces robust: User interfaces should be designed to be as robust as possible in the face of changing technology. This encompasses being able to present content containing newer technologies by older user agents as well as designing content to be usable with future technologies.

availableConstraints.description: 应用程序页面应设计为在预期技术使用环境下有可接受的打开和下载时间
availableConstraints.sourceText: Application pages should be designed and implemented so that there are acceptable opening times and download times for the expected range of technical contexts of use (e.g. bandwidth between the application and the user). This is particularly important for frequently accessed pages or pages that are important for user navigation and exploration, such as the home page.

availableConstraints.description: 应尽量减少潜在用户错误和从错误中恢复所需的努力
availableConstraints.sourceText: Minimizing user errors: Potential user errors as well as the effort needed to recover from errors should be minimized.

availableConstraints.description: 错误消息应清楚地说明错误原因和可能的解决操作
availableConstraints.sourceText: Providing clear error messages: The content of error messages shown on the pages or special error pages should clearly state the reason why the error occurred and, if possible, actions the user can take to resolve the error. Users expect error messages to be in the same language as the user interface.

availableConstraints.description: 用户应能够调整文本大小
availableConstraints.sourceText: Making text resizable by the user: Text should be able to be resized by the user, using functions provided by the user agent or other appropriate means i.e. see ISO 9241-171.

availableConstraints.description: 文本内容的质量在拼写和语法方面应足够不影响可读性
availableConstraints.sourceText: Text quality: The quality of textual content with respect to spelling and grammar should be sufficient so as not to impede readability.

availableConstraints.description: 应支持快速浏览文本，通过提供清晰的链接、项目符号列表等
availableConstraints.sourceText: Supporting text skimming: Fast skimming of text should be supported by the provision of clear links, bulleted lists, highlighted keywords, logical headings, and short phrases and sentences.

availableConstraints.description: 页面内链接应与其他链接明显区分
availableConstraints.sourceText: Distinguishable within-page links: Within-page links should be clearly distinguishable from other links that lead to a different page. EX. Within-page links are shown with dashed rather than solid underlines

availableConstraints.description: 应避免链接过载，以免影响文本可读性
availableConstraints.sourceText: Avoiding link overload: Text pages containing large proportions of links should be formatted so that the presence of links does not impede the readability of the text.

availableConstraints.description: 导航链接应使用用户熟悉的术语标记
availableConstraints.sourceText: Using familiar terminology for navigation links: Navigation links — particularly links representing the main navigation structure — should be labelled with terms that are familiar to the user, based on his/her general knowledge, prior experience in the application domain or experience of using other systems.

availableConstraints.description: 链接标签应描述性地指示其目标或目的
availableConstraints.sourceText: Using descriptive link labels: The target or purpose of a link should be directly indicated by its label, avoiding generic labels such as 'go' or 'click here' except where the purpose of the link is clear from its context on the page or the labels have commonly understood semantics in the particular application domain. Using appropriate terminology specific to the user's tasks and information needs is important for making the content easy to understand.

availableConstraints.description: 打开新窗口的链接应明确标记
availableConstraints.sourceText: Marking links opening new windows: Links that open new browser windows or pop-up windows should be clearly marked.

availableConstraints.description: 导航链接应与操作控件明显区分
availableConstraints.sourceText: Distinguishing navigation links from controls: Navigation links should be clearly distinguishable from controls activating some action. Typical action types in user interfaces include manipulating application data, performing searches, communication actions, such as opening a new e-mail window or starting a chat function, and presentation-related actions, such as sorting a list of search results.

availableConstraints.description: 如果文档太长或布局不适合在线阅读，应提供可打印版本
availableConstraints.sourceText: Providing printable document versions: If a document is either too long, dispersed over several pages or in a specific layout that is not suitable for online reading, a printer-friendly version of the document should be provided that prints the content in a form acceptable to the user (e.g. in the expected layout, paper format, or orientation).

availableConstraints.description: 应谨慎使用空白，不影响页面的视觉浏览
availableConstraints.sourceText: Use of 'white space': 'White space' on a page i.e. space filled only with the background color should be used in such a way that it does not impair the visual skimming of the page. While white space is an important means of visually organizing the different content elements on a page, if the distance between the blocks of information displayed becomes too large, rapid skimming of the page can be impeded.

availableConstraints.description: 页面长度应根据页面的主要目的和使用情况选择
availableConstraints.sourceText: Selecting appropriate page lengths The length of a page should be selected so as to support the primary purpose and use of the page. Short pages are generally more appropriate for homepages, navigation pages, or overview pages that need to be read quickly. Longer pages can be more appropriate when users want to read the content without interruptions or when the page needs to match a paper counterpart.

availableConstraints.description: 应谨慎使用颜色，不作为传达信息的唯一手段
availableConstraints.sourceText: Using colour: Colour should be used with care, taking into account human capabilities and restrictions in perceiving colour, and not as the only means of conveying information. Color should never be the only means of coding. Some users may have difficulties in perceiving certain colors or color combinations (color-blindness).

availableConstraints.description: 如果使用框架，应避免可能的问题并提供无框架的替代方案
availableConstraints.sourceText: Using frames with care: If frames are used, care should be taken to avoid possible problems, for example, those involving the use of the back button, bookmarking of pages, or scrolling of information. When frames are used, it is important to title each frame, and to describe its purpose and how frames relate to one another other. Providing alternatives to frame-based presentation: If frames are used, an alternative way of presenting relevant information without frames should be provided.
